svg.text: Top view, USB end up. Pin label: header pin, Arduino name, MCU port, Morpho position (grey). Every +5V / GND flag connects to the rails on the interface perfboard.
Grey CN7-/CN10- = same signal on the Morpho inner column.
Grey squares: D13 (PA5) drives LD2, the heartbeat LED;
D0/D1 (PA3/PA2) carry the USB serial. Leave them unwired.
3.3 V is a valid TTL high.

Dashed boxes: optional parts. Pin tables: docs/wiring.md.
